findings.description: The plan covered fresh Claude/Cursor/Codex runtime proof, but did not explicitly require implementation or repair of thin host adapters before proof-only runtime phases.
The final acceptance matrix did not spell out the full user prompt -> universal task -> orchestration plan -> skill selection -> visible host answer path for all three hosts.
Section 8 needed to state that the review table is only an index and that pass evidence must be a distinct packet, not a ledger row.
